name: Fast Path Check
description: Advises TPM at session start when the workspace lives on a slow /mnt/c/... path so the user can move to a WSL-native location for faster I/O.

fastpathDirectory.label: Fast Path Directory
fastpathDirectory.description: Parent directory the launcher looks under for a matching workspace subdirectory when Workspace Repository Resolution is on, or cd's into directly when off. Leave blank to auto-compute a target from the workspace path.

autoCdIntoRepo.label: Workspace Repository Resolution
autoCdIntoRepo.description: When on (default), opens the terminal in your repo's matching subdirectory under Fast Path Directory if one exists. When off (or no match found), opens Fast Path Directory itself.

offerMigration.label: Offer Migration
offerMigration.description: When on (default), TPM offers to walk through migrating the workspace off a detected slow /mnt/c/... path. When off, TPM only emits the detect-and-advise message.

migrationStrategy.label: Migration Strategy
migrationStrategy.description: Migration strategy. clone (default): does a git clone of the remote into the new path. rsync: copies the working tree including uncommitted changes (slower). ask: prompts the user each time.

postMigrationChecks.label: Post-Migration Checks
postMigrationChecks.description: When on (default), TPM runs post-migration sanity checks (install, build, confirm remote, confirm uncommitted changes preserved). When off, migration ends after the copy step.
